principle: least privilege, short-lived credentials, human approvals for irreversible actions

profiles.name: scoped-engineering
user_approval_required_for: enabling setup-network access in Codex environment

services.name: GitHub
services.required: repo code read, new development branch write, PR draft, Actions/logs read via connected GitHub identity
services.not_required: organization admin, branch protection write, delete repository, edit secrets

services.name: Go / Flutter / Android packages
services.required: temporary outbound access to trusted official package hosts for setup; pinned versions and checksums where possible

services.name: Google Play
services.not_required: Play console login, publish tokens, signing keys

services.name: 3D / artwork
services.required: owned/licensed project art plus approved Blender tooling
services.not_required: paid API keys or copying restricted art from arbitrary sources

services.name: Database / production service
services.required: isolated local test database only until technical design approval

services.name: Monitoring
services.required: test logs and synthetic non-sensitive events
services.not_required: live user data or personal health/financial information

credential_protection: No tokens in repository, chat text, screenshots, shell arguments, logs or PR descriptions.
Use connected GitHub authorization instead of user-supplied PAT when possible.
When external credentials are unavoidable, scope to non-production tasks and supply via approved environment credential controls.
Only the user/workspace admin may grant platform access. This document cannot change permissions.
